prompt: Your group needs ideas for a school fundraiser, but every suggestion gets criticised the moment it is spoken. Which ground rule is most likely to produce more ideas?

options.text: Only the group leader is allowed to suggest ideas
Vote on each idea as soon as it is spoken
List as many ideas as possible first without judging them, then evaluate the list together afterwards
Pick the first workable idea to save time

explanation: Separating generating ideas from judging them stops early criticism from shutting people down, so the group ends up with a longer, more varied list to choose from.
